tasks_completed.description: Fixed showsHorizontalScrollIndicator for code block ScrollView
tasks_completed.rationale: Unconditional false suppressed scroll indicator on all platforms; web users need the indicator to discover horizontally scrollable code blocks
Inverted Platform check showed indicator on native but hid it on web; flipped to correct logic

git_rationale.root_cause_commit: 7f178466 - fix: fix monorepo (code moved from expo-app, bug predates monorepo restructure)
git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: Original code was written for mobile where hiding scroll indicators is standard UX. Web platform was not considered; table Platform check was written backwards (!== instead of ===).
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: Both scroll indicator props now use Platform.OS === 'web', which shows indicator on web and hides it on native — consistent correct behavior for both content types

dev.tdd_skip_reason: Pure prop value change on existing ScrollView components; not programmatically reproducible in unit tests. QA verifies visually in browser by rendering a session with wide code blocks and tables.
dev.qa_notes: On dev.life-ai.app, open a session with a wide code block (e.g. long line of code) and a wide table. Verify horizontal scrollbars are visible on web. On iOS/Android, verify scrollbars remain hidden.

recommendations: Consider adding a CSS thin-scrollbar style for web to improve aesthetics (out of scope for this fix)
